picks.name: The Case of the Bone Bandit
picks.description: Bridge City Children's Theatre performs The Case of the Bone Bandit at Bethany Village Plaza — a free, live interactive mystery show for kids. Great for little ones and curious adults alike.

picks.name: New Stuff Comedy Showcase
picks.description: Portland comics test fresh material in a low-pressure showcase at Al's Den. The best way to get a taste of the local Portland comedy scene — and the perfect excuse for a weeknight out at McMenamins.

picks.name: PDX Burger Week
picks.description: 100+ Portland restaurants offer special $10 burgers all week long. Classic smashburgers, creative mashups, vegan options — the whole city plays along. Download the map and make your list. Runs Aug 10–16.

picks.name: Puzzled Pint August
picks.description: A monthly puzzle hunt where you can solve the puzzle to find the secret bar — then tackle more puzzles over drinks. Download the puzzle at puzzledpint.com to find Tuesday's venue. Beginner-friendly, team-based, and genuinely fun.

picks.name: Morning Music with Mr. Ben
picks.description: Kids' musician Mr. Ben brings live music to The Heist Food Carts on SE Woodstock for a free Wednesday morning show. Perfect for toddlers and little kids — stick around after for breakfast from the carts.
picks.venue: The Heist Food Carts, SE Woodstock

picks.name: OMSI Star Party
picks.description: Rose City Astronomers host a free public star party at Rooster Rock State Park. Volunteers set up telescopes — you can look through theirs or bring your own. Great views of Jupiter and Saturn this time of year. $10 parking.

picks.name: Topaz Farm Storytime
picks.description: Free outdoor storytime at Topaz Farm on Sauvie Island — one of Portland's most beloved summer farm destinations. After the stories, wander the farm, say hello to the animals, and soak up the Sauvie Island vibes.

picks.name: How to Train Your Dragon
picks.description: Portland Parks screens How to Train Your Dragon (2025) at Wilshire Park — free outdoor movie night for the whole family. Free popcorn provided. Bring a blanket, snacks, and something warm for when the sun goes down.

picks.name: Rockstar Energy Open
picks.description: The Rockstar Energy Open comes to Tom McCall Waterfront Park for a free day of action sports. Head down to the waterfront and see what's on.

picks.name: TMNT Ride
picks.description: Dress as your favorite Ninja Turtle and ride through Portland with the crew. The group departs from MixTape Vintage on SE Belmont — show up in your best shell and mask. Cowabunga.

picks.name: PDX Adult Soapbox Derby
picks.description: Portland's legendary annual tradition: 40+ teams race hand-built gravity-powered cars down Mt. Tabor's streets in front of thousands of spectators. The 27th year of this volunteer-run event — free to watch, wildly entertaining.

picks.name: Rave of Dragons
picks.description: A dragon and fantasy-themed rave at Nova PDX, Portland's oldest continuously operating live music venue. Dress to theme and come ready to dance at one of Portland's great underground spots.

picks.name: Portland Criterium + Party on, Portland!
picks.description: Two free Sunday events: closed-street criterium bike racing at the North Park Blocks in the morning, and EcoLloyd's Party on, Portland! block party at Holladay Park starting at 11 AM — live music, food, and entertainment while you watch high speed road bike racing.

picks.name: ZooBomB Summer Series
picks.description: Portland's beloved Sunday night tradition: grab a tiny bike (or bring your own), ride MAX up to the West Hills, and bomb back down in a pack. Meet at SW 13th & Burnside. Bring a light and a helmet.
